files.title: File:Coast Guard Station St. Joseph accepts new 45-foot RB-M 140508-G-ZZ999-002.jpg
files.author: U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 1st Class Christopher Dougherty
files.caption: A boat crew aboard a new 45-foot response boat maneuvers the boat near the St. Joseph, Mich., Lighthouse as the crew of Coast Guard Station St. Joseph accepts the new platform, May 8, 2014. The new boat will increase the crew's ability to respond to search-and-rescue cases and will also be used as a law enforcement platform.
